description: One operational expense, captured from the receipt itself. A foreman photographs the slip in the field, on-device OCR reads the merchant, the total and the date off it, and this is where that lands — with the photo, the raw OCR text and the scanner's own confidence kept beside the extracted fields so a bookkeeper can always check the machine's reading against the paper. Status moves Draft to Submitted to Approved or Rejected; approval and rejection each record who acted and when, and a rejection records why.

fields.description: The vendor as it reads on the receipt.
fields.label: Merchant

fields.description: The receipt total, including tax. Optional on a Title/MCO or Bill of Sale, which records a document rather than money spent.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Money coming BACK — a part returned to the counter, a core charge refunded. The amount stays POSITIVE (it is the magnitude the slip prints); this box is what says which way it went. It is what makes the bank matcher look at credits instead of withdrawals, so a return left unticked will never find its deposit.
fields.label: Return / Refund

fields.description: The employee who photographed the receipt.
fields.label: Submitted By

fields.description: The Supplier this receipt is from, where the merchant is one this operation has a record for. OPTIONAL and separate from `merchant`, which stays exactly as the paper reads it: a slip printed 'VALLEY CO-OP #14' and a Supplier called 'Valley Co-operative' are the same vendor, and overwriting one with the other loses the evidence. Linking is what lets a year of fuel be totalled per vendor and what a 1099 pre-fill reads.
fields.label: Supplier

fields.description: Where this cost is booked for reporting, if the operation tracks that below Company. OPTIONAL — a receipt with no cost center still totals fine at the company level. Hidden on a co-op equity purchase or a patronage dividend, which are not operating costs.
fields.label: Cost Center

fields.description: The job this expense was incurred for, if there is one.
fields.label: Farm Task
Document Type
fields.options:
Vehicle Title
MCO
Bill of Sale
Registration

fields.description: The VIN (or a tractor's serial number) as printed on the document. Used to find the Vehicle or Tractor this document belongs to when Linked Asset is left empty.
fields.label: VIN

fields.description: The Vehicle or Tractor this document belongs to. Linking it also sets the asset's Title Document.
fields.label: Linked Asset

fields.description: The cooperative this equity or patronage is with, as it should be totalled. Defaults to the merchant line.
fields.label: Co-op Name

fields.description: Set by the app on a Co-op Equity receipt: the money bought an asset (an equity stake), so it is not an expense and is left out of expense totals.
fields.label: Balance Sheet Item
Reimburses Receipt
fields.description: On a Reimbursement receipt: the expense this check pays back part or all of. Optional. When set, post_reimbursement_receipt credits that expense's own account, and the reimbursements linked to one expense may not add up to more than it.

fields.label: Check Number
fields.description: On a Reimbursement receipt: the number in the check's corner. post_reimbursement_receipt carries it as the Journal Entry's reference number when the deposit has not been matched to a Bank Transaction yet.

fields.label: Check Memo
fields.description: On a Reimbursement receipt: what the payer wrote on the memo line.
The photograph the extracted fields were read off. Keep it: it is the only thing that outlives a disagreement about what the slip said.
fields.label: Receipt Image

fields.description: Whatever line detail the scanner could read. A receipt with no legible lines is still a valid expense — the total is the field that matters.
fields.label: Items

fields.description: The scanner's own confidence in its reading, 0 to 1. A low number is not an error; it is a receipt somebody should look at.
fields.label: OCR Confidence

fields.description: Everything the scanner read, unedited. The audit trail behind every field above it.
fields.label: OCR Raw Text

fields.description: Why it was refused, in the words of whoever refused it. Required to reject.
fields.label: Rejection Reason

fields.description: What this receipt turned into, if anything: create_purchase_invoice_from_receipt writes 'Purchase Invoice' here, create_owner_draw writes 'Journal Entry'. Blank means nothing has been posted from this receipt yet.
fields.label: Linked Document Type

fields.description: The document create_purchase_invoice_from_receipt or create_owner_draw produced from this receipt. A DRAFT — posting it is a separate, later step.
fields.label: Linked Document

fields.description: The Bank Transaction this receipt is the paper for. Set by match_receipt_to_bank_transaction, never inferred and never written in bulk — a proposed match is reviewed by a person before it becomes this field. Blank means the money for this receipt has not been found on a statement, which is a worklist, not an error.
fields.label: Bank Transaction

fields.description: How the link was made. `Manual` is a person naming both documents; `Proposed` is a match accepted from auto_match_receipts, which scored it but did not commit it. The distinction is what lets an auditor ask how much of a season's reconciliation a machine suggested.
fields.label: Match Method

fields.description: How alike the receipt and the transaction were, 0 to 1 — amount, date proximity and merchant against the bank's memo line. Evidence for the link, not a gate on it: a person who names both documents is right whatever the score says.
fields.label: Match Confidence

fields.description: What the scanner read, before somebody corrected it. Empty on a receipt nobody has had to correct — read the two timestamps, not the two originals: a Currency column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 on a real site, so an untouched original_amount reads 0.00 and not blank.
fields.label: Corrections

fields.description: The amount as first captured. Written ONCE, by the first correction; a second correction does not overwrite it.
fields.label: Original Amount

fields.description: Set means the amount has been corrected. THIS is the column to test, not original_amount.
fields.label: Amount Corrected At

fields.description: The receipt date as first captured. Written ONCE, by the first correction.
fields.label: Original Date

fields.description: Set means the receipt date has been corrected. THIS is the column to test.
fields.label: Date Corrected At
